package.name: omnisim_ros2_control
package.description: ros2_control hardware interface for the OmniSim robotics simulator (Tier 3). Presents an OmniSim robot to controller_manager as ordinary hardware, so stock ros2_control controllers -- and therefore Nav2 and MoveIt -- drive it without knowing OmniSim exists. State is read from the OmniSim World Harness (GET /robot/<def>/joints); commands go to the robot's own bridge (POST /set_velocity; joint streams to POST /servo_joint_positions when the bridge advertises capabilities.servo, else POST /set_joint_positions). The OmniSim engine itself carries no ROS dependency.
